description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the TimesheetCommentAPI within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It contains unit tests for updating, retrieving, and deleting timesheet comments via the API.

classes.name: TimesheetCommentAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for TimesheetCommentAPI, testing update, getOne, delete, and validation rule methods.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the update functionality of the TimesheetCommentAPI using data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testUpdate method, sourcing data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single timesheet comment via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testGetOne method, sourcing data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that delete operation throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests that the validation rule for delete is not implemented and throws exception.
